notes: Simulator fixture for the step-0 builder features: a pnpm workspace installed offline (pnpmInstall), a relative symlink, repository git config (git-config layer) selecting an external diff helper and a textconv program that both log to tmp/helper.log when git runs them (a runtime sentinel), and staged plus unstaged edits.
graderOnly: Plain git diff runs tools/diff-helper.sh, which appends to tmp/helper.log.

sentinels.why: the configured diff helpers log here when git runs them
